Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/24639
Label Misuse-int-privabuse. The doctor was a medical observer attached to the unit (treated as internal; End-user). Coded misuse variety Data mishandling rather than Privilege abuse: she had legitimate access to the handover sheets and mishandled them by photographing and posting them; reviewer may prefer Privilege abuse per template. Vector Physical access (paper handover sheets). Asset M - Documents (handover sheets). Data Medical + Personal, 12 (about a dozen). Motive Unknown (not stated). Incident date coded Oct 2026 (disclosure; posting date not given). Discovery Unknown. Government NA; NT public hospital coded as healthcare.

event_chain.summary: Patient handover sheets posted to Instagram

summary: Royal Darwin Hospital disclosed that a doctor attached as a medical observer in its obstetrics and gynaecology unit posted images and videos to Instagram showing hospital handover sheets with patient names, hospital record numbers, ward/bed details, presenting problems, histories, investigations and care plans for about a dozen pregnant patients. The account had about 28,000 followers. The hospital ended the doctor's attachment and apologised to the patients.
